marta: Quick sync: need to make the Optimize toolkit roadmap risk-adjusted for the pilot launch. Customer asks piling up — batching suggestions, cache TTLs, quant recommendations, and eval-triggered alerts. Can we align on minimum launch criteria?
aj: From infra: batching + continuous batching is stable, but KV cache hit-rate depends on prefix reuse. Need SLOs for latency at p95 with batching on.
liam: We have pilot data from Acme and Atlas — batch sizes 8-32 gave ~25-40% cost improvements but added ~30-80ms p95. Important: make batching per-route opt-in/opt-out.
katie: Customer requests: per-route quantization recs (8-bit vs 4-bit), a 'safety' revert for quality regressions, and eval alerts when ROUGE/LLR drifts > threshold. Also they want a concise rollout checklist.
marta: Proposed launch gating: 
```
- E2E integration tests with representative workloads
- Default batching policy (auto+bounds) + per-route override
- Quantization recommendation engine with easy rollback
- Eval-triggered Slack alerts + auto-ticket creation
- Canary rollout (config + metrics)
```
Thoughts?
aj: Add: cost-estimation UI for predicted token savings pre-apply. Ops needs it to sign off.
liam: We should surface examples where quantization reduced quality — document these in launch notes. Also: canary config = 5% traffic, 24h monitor window, evaluate on production prompt set.
katie: :thumbsup: agree. For eval alerts, suggest thresholds + lookback windows. Example: `LLR drop > 0.05 over 1000 evals` or `embedding cosine drop > 0.02 over 500 samples`. Also include noise floor checks.
sahil: On prioritization: per-route recs should be tiered — Dedicated/private customers first, hosted beta later. That reduces blast radius and gives better signal.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created canary cluster `optimize-pilot-canary` at 1951234600.
marta: Action items: aj -> add batching SLOs + API flags; liam -> collate pilot metrics & failure examples; katie -> draft launch checklist + alert thresholds; sahil -> map customer tiers and rollout cadence. Reconvene Wed 11am.
aj: I'll open the SLO + API ticket, ETA Tue EOD.
liam: Collating metrics now, will post a short summary in the thread by tomorrow.
